newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-BLEWETT SIGNS TWO-YEAR CONTRACT FOR MIDDLESEX.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-BLEWETT SIGNS TWO-YEAR CONTRACT FOR MIDDLESEX.

text.p: Australian all-rounder Greg Blewett has accepted a contract to play for English county side Middlesex in 1997 and 1998.

Blewett scored centuries in each of his first two tests against England in the 1994-95 series but has been unable to hold a place in the Australian side and has apparently ruled himself out of contention for next year's Ashes tour,

He replaces pace bowler Dion Nash as Middlesex's overseas player. The New Zealander, who had been suffering from a long-standing back injury, did not play a match this year and was released fron his contract early.
"We are confident Blewett will prove a major boost to the early-order batting and a useful addition to the bowling ranks as a seamer," a Middlesex spokesman said on Friday.
